# Step - profile_with

`profile_with` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Rust-API spelling of profile(ProfileType).

## Forms

```text
profile_with(arg1: ProfileType)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().profile_with(ProfileType.Memory).to_table().contains("Mem")   // true
```
